snippet.title: You Are NOT Bunnygirl - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Guide Bunnygirl through a lab of malfunctioning robots in this RPG about self-care! Learn how to weaponize her emotions in combat and meet unhinged robots who seem to know more about her than she does. Can you protect Bunnygirl? And...who is she, anyway??

It's finally here!! I've been developing this game for 5 and a half years, and it's about to release. I'll finally have free time again!! (and other lies we tell ourselves). Thank you all for your support over the past half decade! I can't wait for y'all to see what I've been COOKIN
